terminology.canonicalReality: kernel-owned authoritative memory state; specialists are projections or candidate producers only
terminology.evidence: immutable/append-only record of what was observed or reported
terminology.claim: interpreted assertion grounded by evidence but not automatically trusted
terminology.belief: possibly probabilistic/conflicted interpretation distinct from evidence
terminology.transaction: atomic canonical mutation unit with explicit outcome
terminology.authority: protected source/policy class that determines what may establish or change canonical truth

memoryStore.name: MemoryStore
guarantees: partial transaction never masquerades as committed
canonical durability never depends on disposable projection success
backend semantics do not establish trust or authority
content-addressed blobs verify hash on read
history is append-preserving; rollback never silently erases history
